original_record.question:
A panel is composed of 4 circles. When Lucy touches a circle, this circle and the others that touch this circle change their color from white to black or from black to white, as shown in the picture. Starting with all white circles, at least how many circles must Lucy touch, one after the other, so that all circles turn black?
<image1>
original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.panels: before and after2x2 touching circle panels separated by right arrow; glove index touches upper-left circle
inventory.pictogram: white glove with native closed cubic contour, gray-purple outline and index crease

answer_verification.method: Enumerate16 parity press vectors of self+orthogonal-neighbor toggles; unique vector producing all black from all white is1111. Repeating any circle twice cancels, hence minimum4. Illustrated single press maps1000 to0110.
